title: Nursing Officer – 196 Posts
qualification: All four post codes accept candidates holding any one of the following nursing qualifications from an Indian Nursing Council (INC) recognised institution: B.Sc. (Honours) in Nursing , B.Sc. Nursing (regular course) , Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing , or Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery/Psychiatric Nursing . Whether a candidate's qualification falls under "diploma holder" or "degree holder" post codes depends on the nature of their original nursing programme, so candidates should match their qualification carefully against the official notification before selecting a post code. || In addition to the nursing qualification, every applicant must have working knowledge of Hindi and a valid, renewed permanent registration certificate from the Uttarakhand Nurses and Midwives Council, Dehradun , issued on or before 2 July 2026 . Importantly, an NUI card or a mere receipt of registration application is not accepted — only the permanent registration certificate qualifies. A desirable (optional) qualification of either 2 years of Territorial Army service or an NCC 'B' or 'C' certificate can strengthen an application but is not mandatory.
salary: Candidates asking about pay can note that all four post codes carry an identical salary structure, since the post grade does not vary by gender or qualification type. Selected Nursing Officers will be placed at Pay Level 7 of the 7th Pay Commission, drawing Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 per month , with pay fixed as per prevailing government rules and a contributory pension applicable to the post.
age_limit: The age cut-off date for this recruitment is fixed at 1 July 2025 , not the application closing date. Candidates must be at least 21 years old and not older than 42 years as on that date, with relaxation available to specific reserved categories domiciled in Uttarakhand. || Only one age relaxation benefit applies per candidate, even if eligible for multiple categories , so candidates should claim the one most favourable to them rather than expecting cumulative relaxations.
application_fee: The fee structure for this recruitment is category-based, paid entirely online, and is non-refundable once submitted — even if the candidate later cancels the application . Below is the exact amount payable by category. || Ex-Servicemen from Uttarakhand pay the fee applicable to their own social category (General/SC/ST/OBC), not a separate concessional rate. Payment can be made via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI, and an application without completed payment will be rejected outright.

salary: The salary for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator positions is benchmarked against the minimum wages for semi-skilled manpower as notified by the respective state government. This means the actual take-home pay will vary depending on the state where you are posted. || Since each state government periodically revises minimum wage notifications, candidates should check the current semi-skilled minimum wage applicable in their state to understand the exact compensation they can expect. title: Court Type
qualification: Eligibility requirements differ slightly for the two posts, mainly in typing and shorthand speed criteria. Both posts require a graduation degree along with computer and language proficiency.
age_limit: Age eligibility is calculated as on a fixed reference date, and several categories receive age relaxation, which is summarised below. || The age of candidates is calculated as on 1 January 2026 . Candidates must be between 21 and 35 years , i.e., born between 2 January 1991 and 1 January 2005 (both dates inclusive).
application_fee: The examination fee varies by category and must be paid online only, through credit card, debit card, net banking, or UPI.
selection_process: Selection is based purely on a written objective-type competitive examination, conducted offline or online, followed by document/record verification. This section explains the marking scheme and qualifying criteria. || The written exam will be of140 marks, of objective multiple-choice type, lasting2 hours 30 minutes, covering General Knowledge and General Studies. || A separatetyping/shorthand skill test worth 60 markswill also be conducted; the detailed syllabus will be published separately on the UKSSSC website. || Minimum qualifying marks:45% for General and OBC categorycandidates, and35% for SC/ST categorycandidates. Candidates scoring below this will be considered unqualified. || Each question carries 4 answer options;1 mark is awarded for each correct answer, and0.25 marks (1/4) are deducted for each incorrect answer. || Marking more than one option for a question is treated as a wrong answer and attracts negative marking. || No negative marking applies to unattempted questions. || The typing/shorthand test isqualifying in nature. If two candidates score equal marks in the written exam and equal marks in Hindi typing/shorthand, preference is given to the one who also qualifies in English typing/shorthand. If a tie still remains, the older candidate is ranked higher in the merit list.
